title: Temporal roughness of local HRV and age: a negative transfer test dominated by window-completeness selection
abstract: Temporal roughness of five-minute logRMSSD did not improve the registered cross-dataset age-group prediction: Brier loss increased by0.02327 (joint bootstrap95% interval -0.05341 to0.07889). Requiring twelve complete windows retained only4/54 external participants, preventing a credible general transfer claim.
